history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration make appropriate disclosure on the funds received in its budget documents to ensure transparency.
history.administration_response: The Administration has implemented this recommendation in the 2025 programme plan and budget, which discloses additional information on extrabudgetary resources. For the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs 2025 programme plan and budget, the Administration has disclosed in a footnote the estimated extrabudgetary resources for the Central Emergency Response Fund, country-based pooled funds and specially designated contributions presented in the proposed programme budget document. For section 3 (including the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs), the footnote refers to the Peacebuilding Fund. The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and will request its closure during the interim audit for the financial year 2024.
history.board_assessment: Given that no improvements have been made in the latest programme budget, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration make appropriate disclosure on the funds received in its budget documents to ensure transparency.
history.administration_response: The Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget considers this recommendation to be implemented. It was implemented in the programme plan and budget for 2025, in which additional information on extrabudgetary resources was disclosed. For section 27 (Humanitarian assistance), the Administration disclosed in a footnote the estimated extrabudgetary resources for the Central Emergency Response Fund, country-based pooled funds and specially designated contributions (see supporting documentation). For section 3 (Political affairs), including the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs, the footnote refers to the Peacebuilding Fund (see para. 29 of supporting document A/78/5 (Vol. I), chap. II). Peacebuilding Support Office: The report on the proposed programme budget for 2025 (A/79/6 (Sect. 3)) now includes the following footnote from the Peacebuilding Support Office: “Excludes the estimated allocations by the Peacebuilding Fund, which amounted to $202.5 million for 2023 and are estimated to be $150 million for 2024 and $400 million for 2025”. The Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that country-based pooled funds, the Central Emergency Response Fund and specially designated contributions have been disclosed in section 27 of the proposed programme budget for 2025 (A/79/6 (Sect. 27)/ Corr.1), the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
